ColorTokens.title: Color tokens
ColorTokens.intro: Every colour the app paints with is a CSS custom property in src/app/globals.css: the light variant on :root, the dark variant on .dark. This page reads that file when Storybook builds, so the swatches below are the values the app ships, not a copy.
ColorTokens.usage: Components never reach for a hex value. They use the Tailwind utility that points at the token (bg-card, text-muted-foreground, text-gold), and the theme switch does the rest.
ColorTokens.exceptions: A few pairs are not a straight swap between variants. --gold is a darkened bronze on light, because bright amber fails WCAG AA as text on ivory; bright amber lives in --amber for large fills and glows. --ticket stays cream in both variants, so a ticket never reads as a prize.

Typography.title: Typography
Typography.intro: The app sets everything in two faces, loaded through next/font in the locale layout and exposed as --font-geist-sans and --font-geist-mono. Storybook loads the same two from Google Fonts in preview-head.html and manager-head.html.
Typography.sansUse: Headings, the wordmark, poster numbers and all interface copy. Display text is set at weight 800 with slightly tightened tracking; body copy at 400.
Typography.bodySample: Listen for the difference between ship and sheep before you read the notes.
Typography.monoUse: Code, timecodes and anywhere digits need to line up.
Typography.eyebrowUse: Section labels are Geist at 12px, bold, uppercase and spaced at 0.32em, in gold. Use the Eyebrow component rather than rebuilding the style.
